>_ Episode 6.2 · Aug 13, 2026 · 1h 11m

Hank Green and His AI Thing | Two AI Scandals

Play Episode 6.2 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube SpotifyApple Podcasts

In this episode of Philosophy Programs and Prompts, Casey Hart (@OntologyExplained) and Carl Brown (@InternetOfBugs) dive deep into the recent controversy surrounding Hank Green and the broader fallout of using large language models (LLMs) in content creation.

Prompted by the viral "I appreciate the pushback" incident, Casey and Carl dissect why audiences react so strongly to undisclosed AI usage, whether it stems from a breach of authenticity, quality degradation, or systemic distrust. Carl breaks down his own past interactions regarding SciShow’s coverage of AI, and both hosts have an open, transparent discussion on how they integrate AI tools into their own production workflows—from audio cleanup and research to SEO and script critique—without losing their personal voice.

Finally, they tackle the critical question: Should everyday creators and individuals establish their own personal AI use policies?
